ओटीटी की दुनिया से आई है एक बेहद चटपटी और चौंकाने वाली खबर! 🎬
एक्टर अनूप सोनी ने Netflix की सीरीज Shaque : Trust No One से अपने सीन्स कटने पर निराशा जताई है। 🛑
शनिवार को अनूप ने इंस्टाग्राम पर डिलीट किए गए सीन्स शेयर करते हुए लिखा कि इन सीन्स को बनाने में बहुत मेहनत लगती है। 📱
वीडियो में अनूप जख्मी हालत में को-स्टार Vicky Arora के साथ नजर आए और दूसरे क्लिप में वह हांफते हुए दिखे। 🏃‍♂️
अनूप का कहना है कि राइटर, डायरेक्टर, एक्शन डायरेक्टर और पूरी टीम की मेहनत के बाद भी कई बार सीन्स फाइनल कट का हिस्सा नहीं बन पाते। 🎥
उन्होंने माना कि यह फिल्ममेकिंग का हिस्सा है और कहानी के हित में कभी-कभी ऐसा करना पड़ता है। 🎬
क्या आपके हिसाब से मेकर्स को कलाकारों के ऐसे मेहनत वाले सीन्स कभी नहीं हटाने चाहिए? 🤔

ctx.title: Anup Soni expresses disappointment over his deleted scenes from Parineeti Chopra-starrer Shaque, says a lot of hard work went into them
ctx.summary: Anup Soni posted scenes cut from Netflix’s Shaque: Trust No One, expressing disappointment over the work that went into them.
ctx.text:
Actor Anup Soni , who recently played Inspector Khurana in Netflix’s mystery thriller Shaque : Trust No One, starring Parineeti Chopra and Jennifer Winget, took to Instagram on Saturday to express his disappointment over some of his scenes being deleted from the show.
Sharing the deleted scenes on Instagram, Anup mentioned in the caption that a lot of hard work goes into creating such sequences, but they sometimes fail to make the final cut. One video shows a wounded Anup being tackled by his co-star Vicky Arora, followed by a sequence in which he strangles the actor. Other clips show Anup running out of breath with a camera attached to his waist.
Expressing his disappointment that these sequences did not make it to the final cut, Anup wrote in the caption, “A few sequences of Khurana Saab from SHAQUE that didn’t make it to the final version,A lot of thought, time, effort and resources go into creating these sequences, with the writers, director, action choreographers, actors, cinematographer, producer and the entire crew contributing to the process.”
He also acknowledged that this is part of the filmmaking process. He wrote, “There can be a little disappointment when a sequence doesn’t make the final cut, but filmmaking is about the larger picture, and sometimes, leaving something out serves the story better. It’s all part of the process.”
Shaque: Trust No One is directed by Rensil D’Silva and produced by Siddharth P Malhotra and Sapna Malhotra under Alchemy Productions. The series features Parineeti Chopra in the lead role, alongside Jennifer Winget, Soni Razdan, Anup Soni, Tahir Raj Bhasin, Sumeet Vyas, Harleen Sethi and Dhruv Choudhry in pivotal roles. The show premiered on Netflix on September 24.
Apart from Shaque, Anup was recently seen in The Vvaan: Force of the Forrest, a fantasy thriller starring Sidharth Malhotra and Tamannaah Bhatia. He plays Shashi Bhaiya in the film, which was released in theatres on September 25.
Anup Soni began his acting career in the 1990s. He appeared in television shows such as CID, before gaining wider recognition for playing Bhairon Singh in Balika Vadhu. He became a household name as the host of the crime documentary series Crime Patrol, which he hosted for several years. He aso appears in supporting roles in films, some of these projects include Gangaajal, Apaharan, Hathyar, Prassthanam, Satyameva Jayate 2 and more.
